title: Minimum XOR Path in a Grid
summary: Given a 2D integer array grid of size m * n, find the minimum possible bitwise XOR value among all valid paths from the top-left cell (0, 0) to the bottom-right cell (m - 1, n - 1).
statement: Given a 2D integer array grid of size m * n, find the minimum possible bitwise XOR value among all valid paths from the top-left cell (0, 0) to the bottom-right cell (m - 1, n - 1). At each step, you can move either right or down. The cost of a path is the bitwise XOR of all the values in the cells along that path, including the start and end cells.
constraints: grid is a nonempty rectangular matrix of nonnegative integers.
Move only right or down from the top-left to bottom-right cell.
XOR every visited cell and return the minimum path value.
hints: One cell can be reached with multiple XOR values, and only retaining the smallest intermediate value is unsafe.
Store the full set of reachable XORs per cell.
Union predecessor sets, XOR each value with the current cell, and take the minimum only at the destination.
Every monotone path ends from above or left, so the recurrence enumerates exactly all path XOR values.
editorial: Every monotone path ends from above or left, so the recurrence enumerates exactly all path XOR values.

tests.explanation: The right-down path has XOR 1^2^4=7; down-right has 1^3^4=6, so return six.
The only path contains zero and has XOR zero.
